evidence.abstract: Riemann normal coordinate expansions of the metric and other geometrical quantities, including the geodesic arc-length, will be presented. All of the results are given to fifth-order in the curvature and were obtained using the computer algebra package Cadabra.
evidence.arxiv_title: Riemann Normal Coordinate expansions using Cadabra
